title: Approved Supplier Preference
text: Procurement requests above 1000 USD should prefer approved suppliers with documented compliance, reliable delivery, and clear warranty terms.

title: Budget Control
text: When a budget is provided, the recommended plan should stay within budget when a feasible catalog option exists. If all options exceed budget, the response should clearly mark the plan as over budget.

title: Delivery Risk
text: Urgent onboarding purchases should prefer products with delivery windows of five days or less and sufficient stock for the requested team size.
